findings: obligation_coverage: [The compactness route](knowledge/overview.md#closing-a-sequence-of-equations) needs uniform derivative moduli, a common subsequence, derivative compatibility, exponent interpolation, retained domain and residual continuity; all have explicit locations. Boundary data and PDE estimates are excluded.

fast_route_reconstruction: [Domain before equation](knowledge/nodes/N-H-main.md#domain-before-equation) supplies a C2beta limit, uses the matrix margin to keep it in U, and only then evaluates F there. The order removes the possible domain gap.

slow_step_reproduction: [Interpolation](knowledge/nodes/N-H-compact.md#interpolation) uses min(a,b)<=a^(1-theta)b^theta, theta=beta/alpha, so the vanishing sup-norm factor has a strictly positive exponent. The line-segment identity separately verifies derivative compatibility.

condition_transfer: [Failure models](knowledge/nodes/N-H-boundary.md#failure-models) show that delta_j=1/j allows loss of strict positivity and beta=alpha removes the vanishing interpolation exponent. Translated bumps isolate local versus global convergence.
